BrochureContent.Content:
Colleran Auctioneers are pleased to present 28 Maunsells Park, Maunsells Road, Galway to the market. This spacious four-bedroom semi-detached home is ideally positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac within one of Galway`s most sought-after residential locations, just off Taylors Hill.

Occupied as a cherished family home for over 50 years, this spacious property now awaits a modern touch to begin its next exciting chapter. The accommodation is bright and generously proportioned. On the ground floor, a welcoming entrance hall with guest toilet leads to a living room, separate dining room, kitchen, and a versatile study that would be ideal as a home office, playroom, or additional reception room. Upstairs, there are four spacious bedrooms together with a main family bathroom.

Outside, the house fronts onto a large secure green area, which will prove very attractive to young families. The front garden offers off street parking whilst the large back garden offers space to extend, subject to planning permission whilst still leaving ample privacy and space for a young family.

The location is second to none. Maunsells Park has long been regarded as one of Galway`s premier residential addresses, offering families a wonderful balance of convenience and independence. A selection of excellent primary and secondary schools are within walking distance, while both Galway city centre and Salthill are easily accessible, providing an outstanding range of shops, restaurants, sporting facilities, beaches, and recreational amenities.
